name: Sika Sigunit L-5401 AF
paste:
SIKA® SIGUNIT® L-5401 AF: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF, July 2026, Version 04.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sika_sigunit_l-5401af.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 04.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is a high-performance liquid, alkalifree, set accelerator for shotcrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is suitable for both dry and wet spraying processes and it is used for:
    - Excavation stabilisation in tunnelling and mining
    - Rock, slope and trench stabilisation
    - High quality lining shotcrete
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Shotcrete spraying accelerator
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 04.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF has the following characteristics and advantages:
    - High early strength development
    - Alkali-free
    - Distinct reduction of rebound and dust
    - Improved bond of shotcrete to the substrate
    - Chloride-free, no negative affect on reinforcement steel
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Inorganic aluminium complexes
    - Appearance and colour: Off white suspension
    - Density: ~ 1.44 kg/L
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Substrate: The substrate must be clean, free of loose stones and free of water under hydrostatic pressure.
2.6 Specific advice. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is added at the nozzle. Accurate and constant dosing into the concrete flow is essential. The suitability of the proposed mix design must be tested in field trials be fore commencement of the project. High quality shotcrete requires a w/c ratio of less than 0.5. Temperature of basic mix must be higher than 15°C.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 L IBC
    - Shelf life: 6 months from date of production if stored in original, undamaged and sealed containers.
2.8 Storage conditions. Storage at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C. Protect from direct sun light, frost and contamination. Use clean containers when delivered in bulk. In case of separation of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the suspension has to be homogenised before using. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF must not be stored in standard steel containers.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 04.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 04.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. The correct dosage must be determined by preliminary testing. For layer thicknesses of up to 100 mm applied in one pass, the recommended accelerator dosage is between 5 % and 9 % by weight of binder. Lower ambient and basic mix temperatures require higher dosage of accelerator.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. The accelerator’s effect depends on the content, age and type of cement, as well as on the shotcrete temperature. Furthermore, the shotcrete quality is widely affected by the substrate, the applied layer thickness, the spraying process, the quality of equipment and the application technique. The w/c ratio of the basic concrete mix in the wet spraying process, and the quantity of gauging water in the dry spraying process are also parameters influencing the acceleration effect of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF. When using sulphate resistant cements strength development can be slower. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is not compatible with alkaline shotcrete accelerators. Before using Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the accelerator hoses must be cleaned thoroughly. The use of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF requires technically correct dosing and conveying / spraying technology. Metal parts of the pump and piping that come into direct contact with Sika® Sigunit® L- 5401 AF must be made of stainless steel. Contact your local Sika company for any additional technical support required.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - The accelerator’s effect depends on the content, age and type of cement, as well as on the shotcrete temperature. Furthermore, the shotcrete quality is widely affected by the substrate, the applied layer thickness, the spraying process, the quality of equipment and the application technique. The w/c ratio of the basic concrete mix in the wet spraying process, and the quantity of gauging water in the dry spraying process are also parameters influencing the acceleration effect of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF. When using sulphate resistant cements strength development can be slower. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is not compatible with alkaline shotcrete accelerators. Before using Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the accelerator hoses must be cleaned thoroughly. The use of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF requires technically correct dosing and conveying / spraying technology. Metal parts of the pump and piping that come into direct contact with Sika® Sigunit® L- 5401 AF must be made of stainless steel. Contact your local Sika company for any additional technical support required.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF, July 2026, Version 04.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sika_sigunit_l-5401af.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF, version 15/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-sika-sigunitl-5401af.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF EPD, version 03/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sika-sigunit-l-5401afepd.pdf
    - Document: Sigaunit L-5401 AF, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/c6cb0113-4895-45dd-96a1-a7edf544ae94/Sigunit%2520L5401%2520AF.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, stor age and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
